contract.publicSurface: one browser-equivalent paced session over /api/commands/*, unsafe projection reads and public safe query reads
contract.commandPlan: create-room plus eight reserve-room commands plus one cancel-reservation command
contract.visibilityClock: response-completed-at to observed public read; send/response clocks retained separately
contract.continuousWrites: visibility polling and safe-fence convergence never delay the next paced command; only source snapshot acquisition may gate executor input
contract.safeQueryProof: unsafe projection endpoint plus default public query body and readHead where the list wire supplies it
contract.safePredicate: terminal state for a reservation that a later cohort command mutates; readHead and safeHead remain event-order proofs
contract.conformanceAuthorization: Bearer supplied from protected token-file path; value not persisted
contract.censoredRule: any missing command/unsafe/safe clock is retained as censored and cannot pass

summary.measurementOrigin: response-completed-at-to-observed-public-read; command send/response clocks are retained separately
